title: A-Level Economics (9708) Max pack
blurb: Diagram precision, evaluation language, and data-response habits that examiners tick.
examinerDigest: Label every diagram axis, curve, and equilibrium — unmarked diagrams lose easy marks.
Define key terms in the syllabus wording before applying them to the case.
Evaluation needs a reasoned judgement, not a bolted-on 'however' sentence.
Quote the extract/data explicitly when the question says 'with reference to'.
